sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Purpose This tool converts analyzed interaction data into a formal Work Management (WM) record. It is responsible for initializing the task with the specific technical details required for specialized teams to take action.
Inputs Interaction Sys ID: (Data Type: string) The unique identifier for the original customer interaction.
WorkNotes: (Data Type: string) Internal-facing audit trail and technical findings.
Summary: (Data Type: string) A concise headline for the case (e.g., "Duplicate Payment - Margaret Thornton").
Description: (Data Type: string) The core technical brief for the resolving agent.
Action & Logic Structured Description Assembly: The tool must ensure the Description field includes the following mandatory data points for every work item:
Customer Identity: Full name of the impacted client.
Issue Classification: The specific nature of the discrepancy (e.g., Duplicate Payment).
Action Mandate: The primary technical requirement (e.g., Reverse $1,250.00 from April 9, 2025).
Operational Next Steps: Clear instructions for the agent (Investigate, Process, Notify).
Responsible Group: The specific business unit assigned to the task.
Record Integrity: Maps the Interaction Sys ID to the new record to ensure a unified audit trail for the Quality Reviewer.
Key Outputs New WM Record ID: The system identifier for the generated case.
Success Confirmation: Verification that the record is active and correctly routed to the Responsible Group.
